executable_actions.rationale: Repair the current board-layer harness and evidence binding before hardware diagnosis. Rediscover the exact user-supplied wrapper, source hashes, and Vivado export contexts; generate the missing board testbench only from those facts. Preserve checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, numeric policy/tolerance, DUT functional semantics, and supplied wrapper sources. Add only read-only monitors that record the direct certified-kernel input/output handshakes and lifecycle state. The binding manifest must cover every required Transformer-block weight tensor consumed by the DUT and must exclude model-tail functions outside accelerator scope.

Do not promote to backend or board runtime on any replay result.

The replay is against the same immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, numeric policy/tolerance, semantic testbench behavior, and exact wrapper hashes; monitor instrumentation must not alter data, ordering, backpressure, or lifecycle behavior.

executable_actions.rationale: Convert only current hash-bound replay evidence into a bounded next repair. The disposition must identify the earliest violated board boundary and exact implicated loader, harness, integration, or DUT slice, then require a same-layer rerun. A lower-layer backtrack is permitted only if the direct trace includes current certificate hashes and directly contradicts a named connected-kernel or leaf invariant with correlated core start, ingress, egress, and causal-boundary evidence; a wrapper output-frontier symptom alone is insufficient.

observations: The direct failing board gate is real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface, not an RTL value or protocol failure. Its current blockers are unbound simulation.source_identity_sha256, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and command executable authorization. The board_tb.sv required by functional-simulation preconditions is absent from the board-simulation artifact set.

functional_sim is dependency-blocked and the board semantic-evidence report is consequently absent. Neither constitutes executed VCS, numeric, AXI, DDR, liveness, ordering, or weight-consumption evidence, so no board functional claim is available.

The prior repair feedback identifies a required read-only direct boundary probe at the certified kernel boundary: cycle-correlated input and output valid/ready/accepted counts plus kernel start/completion lifecycle values. The available wrapper-output frontier symptom is localization evidence only; it cannot establish a core fault or reopen the connected kernel.

Hash-validated operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. No current trace asserts a named contradiction of those certificates, and the connected kernel must retain its certified elastic variable-latency ordering and cross-token-overlap semantics.

sacg_memory_truth is authoritative here: 15 active same-scope contamination barriers and 6 open same-scope retry requests remain active. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts may guide repair but are not validated inputs or promotion evidence; the candidate repair artifacts must be content-addressed separately and Stage7 must be rerun.
The conditional design-team router reported no specialist split. No architecture, numeric-policy, memory-layout, or pipeline-semantics change is justified by the supplied evidence.
proposed_actions: Reconstruct the exact board simulation contract from the current user-supplied project and current Vivado export facts, including a generated, hash-bound board testbench with read-only direct certified-kernel boundary monitors.

Rerun the AXI/DDR identity and canonical compile-plan gate before VCS. Only after it passes, perform the current-layer VCS targeted replay, analyzer, and AXI/deadlock diagnostic using the exact bound sources and immutable semantic contract.

Use the resulting direct boundary trace to issue one causal disposition: board-local loader/harness/integration repair and replay, verification-capability repair if observability is still inadequate, or a narrowly scoped lower-layer backtrack only when the trace explicitly contradicts a current lower-layer certificate.
risks: Using a stale identity document, non-authoritative VCS command, copied/simplified wrapper, or substituted testbench would invalidate exact-board evidence even if simulation compiles.

A board simulation replay must preserve the immutable checkpoint, deterministic or real stimulus provenance, target-model generated expected outputs, frozen numeric comparison policy and tolerance, complete Transformer-block tensor catalog, and complete DUT weight-consumption binding. Embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling remain outside DUT scope.

The wrapper output-frontier stall may arise from no core ingress, no lifecycle launch after ingress, retained internal tokens, an unaccepted core output, or board-side propagation. Patching any of those paths before the direct trace would be speculative.
The active contamination barriers and retry requests prohibit promotion and downstream consumption of prior failed artifacts. They are not evidence that a lower layer failed.
If exact project/Vivado discovery yields multiple unresolved wrapper, export-context, or command-authority candidates, selecting one by name would be an unauthorized integration guess.

immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, and functional testbench semantics
no lower-layer reopening without a current hash-bound contradictory trace
edges: single_transformer_layer_kernel certified evidence -> board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system integration evidence
current boundary trace -> causal repair context or conditional lower-layer backtrack

output.summary: Do not repair RTL or reopen certified lower layers. The current board-layer failure is a verification-capability and exact-board-integration binding failure: the simulation identity, Vivado-export compile authority, command authorization, and board testbench artifact are not bound to the current exact sample-project sources. Rebuild a content-addressed exact-board simulation contract with a read-only certified-kernel boundary probe, pass the AXI/DDR static gate, then execute the current-layer targeted VCS replay and localize its earliest causal boundary. Promotion remains blocked.
